engine_api_reduce_block_v4.highlight: Luca's ReduceBlockV4-with-bid PR lacks feedback; tested on DevNet 8 for >1 month, no known technical blockers
Nico: untrusted builders can grieve others via inflated bids when submitted through VC (not BN); VC cannot verify validity
PR updated with Experimental tag; Lighthouse's Mark reportedly opposed — Eitan to follow up with him

hesi_devnet_2_scope.highlight: QuickSlots inclusion list deadline change: not included in Beta 4; no new release planned for HESI DevNet 2
QuickSlots to remain on a feature branch for ~1 more month; Jihoon will retarget PR to feature branch with added tests
Proposal to SFI the two CFI EIPs already on the main HESI branch at Thursday's ACDC

0x00_deposit_handling.highlight: Barnabas proposes: 0x00 deposits post-fork become inactive (high activation epoch) instead of burning 32 ETH
Counter-proposal (heluani/NC): simply drop 0x00 deposits at process_deposit_request; NC has draft PR (EIPs #12533)
Key concern: burning ETH should never be the default outcome for a previously valid on-chain operation

organizational.highlight: Francesco: CFI/SFI process vs. DevNet sequencing is unclear across teams — needs explicit clarification
Proposal to extend ACDT to 90 minutes going forward; end early when agenda is light

QuickSlots kept on feature branch only; not included in HESI DevNet 2
